title: Revert 306
no_spec_change_rationale: No requirement text changes. #306 changed how a new record is written (a temporary file linked to the name). That writer fails on file systems without hard links (#313) and leaves its temporary files where a concurrent writer sweeps them. The create-new writer goes back to what 0.6.0 shipped; #260 reopens for 0.6.2.
acceptance_criteria: On an exFAT volume chough init, chough bug add and chough journal add succeed and write whole records, as in 0.6.0. The create-new writer in src/records.rs is the one 0.6.0 shipped. #305's non-blocking reader and #308's journal lock are unchanged.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are plain text in tasks.md, not checkboxes. The archived change fix-260 and its records stay as history; only code, its test, its case and its changelog fragment are reverted.
